title: Roof Replacement in Portland, OR
summary: In August 2025, French Roofing replaced the roofs on a home and its garage in Portland, OR. The crew tore off three layers of old roofing down to the deck, covered the spaced board sheathing with new half inch CDX plywood, and installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles over synthetic underlayment.
scope: Tore off three layers of old roofing down to the deck on the house and garage
Installed half inch CDX plywood over the spaced board (skip sheathed) areas
Laid Safeguard 30 synthetic underlayment over the deck
Installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles with new drip edge, wall flashing, ridge cap, roof vents and pipe boots
Cleaned up and ran a magnet over the yard for nails
body: This one had three layers of roofing stacked up, and under them the deck was spaced boards with gaps between them, which you can see from inside in the photo below. All three layers came off, the open areas got new plywood so the shingles have a solid deck to sit on, and the new underlayment and shingles went on from there.

faqs.question: Can you take off more than one layer of old roofing?
faqs.answer: Yes. This Portland roof had three layers, and all three came off down to the deck before anything new went on.

faqs.question: What is skip sheathing, and can shingles go over it?
faqs.answer: Skip sheathing is roof boards laid with gaps between them. Shingles need a solid deck, so on this job the crew covered those areas with new half inch CDX plywood before the underlayment and shingles went on.
